result.reason: The operative language adopts New York law and exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts located in New York County, satisfying the preferred position. The change is confined to replacing the unacceptable Singapore law and forum in Section 28.1 and preserves the existing submission, waiver, and temporary-injunctive-relief provisions. Drafting is professional, though the jurisdiction language is unnecessarily duplicated in Sections 28.1 and 28.2.
